run_speech_laser_embeddings_pipeline: run the speech laser embeddings pipeline to encode audio files from TSV manifests into embeddings
create_compute_embedding_job: create a ComputeEmbedding job that encodes a single audio manifest file using a LASER checkpoint
schedule_embedding_jobs: schedule multiple ComputeEmbedding jobs across language directories using a Hydra launcher for batch processing
get_checkpoint_file_by_lang: get the appropriate LASER checkpoint file name for a given language code like en or ru
split_tsv_files_for_chunks: split TSV manifest files into numbered chunks for parallel processing across language directories
